title: 选词填空的词语搭配
goal: 根据搭配限制和上下文选择合适的词语。

points.label: 识别词语之间的搭配限制
结合句意选择合适搭配

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 搭配是经常一起出现的词语组合。词性合适的候选词，还要与句中的词搭配，并符合语境。
例如 make a decision 表示作出决定；gather evidence 表示收集证据。两组搭配的宾语不同。

cards.title: 形容词与名词
rows: The report showed a significant increase.
The graph shows a gradual decline.
The book is a reliable source.
The study examined the long-term effect.

cards.title: 副词修饰
rows: The two questions are closely related.
The results strongly support the claim.
The figures clearly indicate a change.
The team fully understood the task.
The result largely depends on timing.

cards.title: 介词搭配
rows: The effect on costs was small.
They found evidence for the claim.
There was an increase in demand.
Residents gained access to the service.
She accepted responsibility for the report.
The delay resulted in a change.
The result is similar to the earlier finding.
The route is different from the old one.

items.stem: Which verb completes '___ responsibility for the report'?
items.why: take responsibility for 表示承担对某事的责任。
evidence for 表示支持某项主张的证据。

items.stem: The team needs facts before testing its claim. What should it gather?
items.why: 检验主张需要事实，gather evidence 表示收集证据。

items.stem: A measure reduced costs and was easy to apply. Which phrase describes it?
items.why: 措施有效且易于实施，a practical solution 表示切实可行的解决办法。

items.stem: Which adverb completes 'The two findings are ___ related'?
items.why: closely related 表示密切相关。

items.stem: The number rose slowly over several years. Which phrase describes it?
items.why: rose slowly 表示逐渐增加，即 a gradual increase。

groups.fill: Local staff discussed a proposal. They rea{ched} a deci{sion} and gath{ered} some evid{ence} about pub{lic} demand. T{he} proposal sho{wed} a signi{ficant} increase i{n} local inte{rest}. It offered a practical solution to transport problems. Before beginning the project, the staff asked residents about the routes they used and the times at which services were most useful. The responses helped them identify the areas with the greatest demand. They also recorded costs so that a later review could compare the plan with the service actually provided.

items.stem: Which verb completes '___ research into water use'?
items.why: conduct research 表示开展研究。

items.stem: Which preposition completes 'have an effect ___ costs'?
items.why: effect on 表示对某事的影响。

items.stem: Which phrase means that a method is used in many places?
items.why: widely used 表示广泛使用的。

items.stem: The investigation found several facts supporting the claim. What did it provide?
items.why: several facts supporting the claim 说明证据多且支持主张，即 strong evidence。第四项把支持改成了反对。

items.stem: A group lacks money and equipment for its project. What does it have?
items.why: 资金和设备不足对应 limited resources。

items.stem: The project changed costs for many years. What did the study examine?
items.why: for many years 说明变化持续多年，对应 long-term effect。第四项 short-term 与此相反。
